channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?
item.description: Dans cet épisode d’Afrique 360°, Enrica Picco et Rinaldo Depagne reçoivent Frédéric Manantsoa Lai, coordinateur des urgences pour Médecins Sans Frontières, et Onesphore Sematumba, analyste senior pour la République démocratique du Congo et le Burundi à Crisis Group, pour parler de l’épidémie d’Ebola en RDC et de ses conséquences sur la population congolaise, déjà marquée par des années de conflit.

item.title: Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?
item.description: İkinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında şekillenen uluslararası düzen giderek çözülürken, Ankara ve diğer Avrupa başkentlerindeki yetkililer güvenlik alanında birlikte hareket etmedikleri takdirde ciddi risklerle karşı karşıya kalacaklarının giderek daha fazla farkına varıyor. Tehdit algıları farklılık gösterse de, pragmatik ve esnek iş birliği yolları geliştirmeleri hâlâ mümkün. Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?

item.title: Putin 'Underestimated Trump's Commitment To Freedom'
item.description: In an interview with RFE/RL, Republican Senator Rick Scott said Russian President Vladimir Putin did not anticipate the strength of US support for Ukraine's war effort, adding that a new sanctions bill is meant to hold Russia accountable. Putin 'Underestimated Trump's Commitment To Freedom'.

item.title: ' Senator Rick Scott Says Congress Must Hold Russia Accountable
item.description: Influential Republican Senator Rick Scott talks to RFE/RL about why he believes sanctions against Russia should be passed immediately, why Ukraine's military innovations matter for the United States, and why defeating Russia is central to deterring an increasingly coordinated authoritarian bloc. ' Senator Rick Scott Says Congress Must Hold Russia Accountable.

item.title: Russian and Ukrainian drone strikes kill at least 5 in each country
item.description: Since Russia's invasion more than four years ago, Ukraine has developed long-range drones that can hit targets deep inside Russia. In the past year, they have battered oil facilities, major storage depots and other key infrastructure Russian and Ukrainian drone strikes kill at least 5 in each country.

item.title: U.S. Treasury Secretary says chance of Hormuz deal with Iran by August 5
item.description: "We are in talks with the Iranians, and I think there is a chance we may have a deal today or tomorrow to open the strait and move towards a more normalised position in this conflict," says Scott Bessent U. S. Treasury Secretary says chance of Hormuz deal with Iran by August 5. U. U. S.

item.title: US in a losing race to replenish depleted missile arsenals
item.description: The US’s multibillion-dollar push to expand interceptor missile production could begin rebuilding depleted stocks, but long manufacturing lead times, industrial bottlenecks and cost imbalances mean the benefits will depend on how quickly new capacity translates into deployable missiles. The US Department of Defense (DoD) signed framework agreements worth over US$3 billion with defense contractors US in a losing race to replenish depleted missile arsenals.

item.title: Ukrainian Drones Strike 'Russia's Amazon' Near St. Petersburg
item.description: Russian authorities claim Ukrainian drones hit multiple Wildberries warehouses in several regions on August 4. Officials reported damage at facilities near St. Petersburg, and in the Tver and Moscow regions. Ukraine's drone commander said at least 15 Wildberries hubs have been hit since mid-July. Ukrainian Drones Strike 'Russia's Amazon' Near St. Petersburg.

item.title: Africans bear the brunt of biodiversity loss
item.description: For millions across Africa and the developing world, the biodiversity crisis is not an abstract problem – it’s the soil that no longer yields bountiful harvests and the fish that no longer return to coastal waters. Africans bear the brunt of biodiversity loss.

item.title: ‘A playground, a beach, a home’: UNICEF demands end to child deaths in Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: As Russia’s invasion of Ukraine continues, with both sides stepping up airstrikes and drone attacks in recent weeks deep inside each other's territory, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) appealed on Tuesday for greater protection for the war’s youngest victims. ‘A playground, a beach, a home’: UNICEF demands end to child deaths in Russia-Ukraine war.

item.title: New Ebola vaccine trial launches as outbreak spreads in DR Congo
item.description: Results may be months away, but efforts are advancing towards enhanced treatment and the world’s first vaccine for the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, the World Health Organization (WHO) said on Tuesday as deaths and cases rise in the largest ever outbreak on record in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). New Ebola vaccine trial launches as outbreak spreads in DR Congo.

item.title: Russian Drone Hunts Down Market Vendor In Kherson
item.description: Ukrainian National Police have published a video they say shows a Russian drone stalking and attacking a man selling goods at a market in the city of Kherson. The 52-year-old survived but suffered blast trauma, concussion, and shrapnel wounds, according to authorities. Russian Drone Hunts Down Market Vendor in Kherson. Ukrainian police have published a video they say shows a Russian drone stalking and attacking a man selling goods at a market in the city of Kherson.

item.title: Ukrainian Strikes On Russian Warehouses, Including Wildberries, Leave Five Dead
item.description: Ukrainian drones struck two more warehouses used by the online retailer Wildberries, as well as a third in the Moscow region that killed five people as Russia and Ukraine continued exchanging cross-border strikes with US-mediated peace talks stalled. Ukrainian Strikes On Russian Warehouses, Including Wildberries, Leaves 5 Dead. Ukrainian Strikes On Russian Warehouses, Including Wildberries, Leave Five Dead.

item.title: Colombia swears in costumed anti-corruption activist as senator
item.description: Luis Carlos Rúa revealed himself to be Elefante blanco just three days before election for ‘his own safety’. Now he is tackling graft from senate floorWhen 102 senators were sworn in for Colombia’s latest parliamentary session, they included 32 women, 69 men – and one cartoon elephant. Colombia swears in costumed anti-corruption activist as senator.

item.title: Japan’s prime minister tours earthquake-hit sites as recovery efforts hampered by soaring
item.description: Prime minister Sanae Takaichi visited Kumamoto prefecture almost a week after a magnitude 7.1 quake hit, killing 38 peopleJapan’s prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, has visited the south-western prefecture of Kumamoto, where recovery efforts are being hampered by heat and a lack of water supplies, almost a week after a magnitude 7.1 earthquake killed dozens and caused widespread damage. Thirty-eight p Japan’s prime minister tours quake-hit sites as recovery efforts hampered by soaring temperatures.

item.title: Stronger EU borders needed after Ceuta crisis, von der Leyen says
item.description: European Commission president says work needed in five areas of migration control including returning more peopleThe president of the European Commission has called for action to strengthen Europe’s borders after tens of thousands of people arrived and quickly left the Spanish territory of Ceuta, triggering a furious row between Madrid and other European countries. Stronger EU borders needed after Ceuta crisis, von der Leyen says.

item.title: How Ceuta migrant crisis exposes divisions within Europe
item.description: Dozens of people died attempting to reach the Spanish enclave of Ceuta after an estimated 50,000 crossed from Morocco last week. The incident has led to a political crisis in Spain and criticism from EU countries. Lucy Hough speaks to the Guardian’s European community affairs correspondent, Ashifa Kassam – watch on YouTube Continue reading How Ceuta migrant crisis exposes divisions within Europe.

item.title: How India’s ‘Cockroach’ movement grew its wings
item.description: Young people across India recently made international headlines for mass protests over the recurring leaks of entrance exams that help students qualify for medical schools and highly coveted government jobs. item.title: New centre opens at heart of record Ebola outbreak
item.description: New UN-backed centres will serve eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as confirmed Ebola cases continued to climb sharply over the weekend in the largest ever outbreak of the highly contagious disease in the country. New centre opens at heart of record Ebola outbreak.
